payload.text: ST0008, Molt from brew (dev, opt and brew trees): cc built WP01-04 (5bf482a, 3add4f8, unpushed). The vc review found 4 must-fix items (D5 restart keys on commit not keg, drift hardcodes the runtime dirs, --force over a non-Molt manifest, local-bin replaces non-tree links) and 7 smaller ones, all sent to cc, who fixes them together with the D4/D6 shadow and no-bin-link work. Design D4 corrected in a0c1b2e. Next: cc commits; vc pushes and checks CI; cc runs the scratch-tap end to end (hv: go); vc creates matthewsinclair/homebrew-molt (hv: approved); WP05 sleeves.
